evidenceLines: The program is offered over a minimum of three terms. Students will be required to do a major thesis project which consists of two courses: BENV4000 Research Methods (6 UOC) and BLDG4504 Thesis (12 UOC). These two courses provide key research training and critical thinking skills. Students who choose to complete Honours in one of the specialisations will be required to do a thesis project related to their chosen specialisation, 3 core courses, FADA6700, and 1 program elective course. Students who are doing a generalist Honours degree will enrol in FADA6700 and 24 UOC disciplinary electives.
